methods.label: Factor the denominators
methods.explanation: Since \(x^2-1=(x-1)(x+1)\), each denominator factor, \(x-1\) and \(x+1\), is needed only once. Therefore, the least common denominator is \((x-1)(x+1)=x^2-1\).
